question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
-- Final result: first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, with anagram counts
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) IN (4, 5)
    AND words LIKE 'r%'
),
with_sorted AS (
  SELECT words,
         STRING_AGG(char, '' ORDER BY char) AS sig
  FROM filtered,
       UNNEST(STR_SPLIT(words, '')) AS t(char)
  GROUP BY words
),
with_counts AS (
  SELECT words, sig,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sig) AS anagram_count
  FROM with_sorted
)
SELECT words, anagram_count
FROM with_counts
WHERE anagram_count >= 2
ORDER BY words
LIMIT 10
